pageConvention: 1-based physical PDF page, not printed page label

sources.title: MoFA Maize Production Guide
sources.use: Production guidance; use stage-sensitive moisture checks, drainage, rotations and soil testing. No fertilizer rates or germination-temperature alarms.

sources.title: MoFA Tomato Production Guide
sources.use: Production guidance; use drainage and unrelated rotations. Do not propagate the mixed-family example that includes cassava, pesticide rates or inconsistent disease-rotation periods.

sources.title: MoFA Pepper Production Guide
sources.use: Production guidance; use drainage and reproductive-stage moisture guidance. Conflicting annual rainfall/temperature ranges are excluded from automated thresholds.

sources.title: MoFA Cabbage Production Guide
sources.use: Production guidance; use water consistency/head stage, drainage and soil tests. The implausible two-week crop-rotation interval is excluded.

sources.title: National Implementation Guide for GS ARS 1000 Part 1
sources.use: GSA/COCOBOD management/traceability guide, not a MoFA weather-warning bulletin. Use soil analysis and cover as planning reminders only; no certification determination.

sources.title: Agriculture in Ghana: Facts and Figures 2018
sources.use: 2018 statistical reference issued October 2019. Historical seasons and agro-ecology only; no present-day district assignments, planting-onset dates or real-time thresholds.

sources.title: Cassava Development in Ghana: country case study
sources.publisher: Prepared by MoFA; hosted by FAO
sources.file: A review of cassava in Africawith country case studies on Nigeria, Ghana,the United Republic of Tanzania, Uganda and Benin.mht
sources.use: MoFA-prepared Ghana chapter saved as MHTML from FAO. Historical rotation/fertility context only. Capture date is not publication date.

sources.title: Cassava and plantain working notes
sources.publisher: User-supplied; author and institutional provenance unverified
sources.use: Six-page user-supplied cassava/plantain summary; no verified author, date or institutional publisher. Reference review only; excluded from operational field/weather rules.

sources.title: Agriculture in Ghana: Facts and Figures 2021
sources.use: Soil texture and heavier valley-bottom soils support field inspection after rain. Seasonal context is corroborative; regional soil/fertility/rainfall values are not current farm measurements. The foreword contains a 2020 label inconsistent with the cover.

sources.title: Agriculture in Ghana: Facts and Figures 2024
sources.use: Latest supplied statistical edition. Use rainfall-distribution and local-season planning context, not current rainfall, exact planting dates, soil nutrient estimates or automatic crop suitability. Regional aggregation footnotes and apparent table inconsistencies prevent operational rainfall-anomaly rules.

sources.title: Green manure/cover crops and crop rotation in Conservation Agriculture on small farms
sources.use: Transferable surface-cover, evaporation/runoff protection and crop-compatibility planning principles, corroborated by Ghana extension guidance. Do not transfer Paraguay planting months, species prescriptions, yield/income gains, fertilizer equivalents, frost rules or density schedules to Ghana. Official icm12.pdf matches the local 109-page pagination; the alternate i2190e00.pdf has 108 pages and is not used for page links.
sources.file: Green manurecover crops and crop rotation in Conservation Agriculture rotation in Conservation Agriculture on small farms.pdf

sources.title: Agriculture in Ghana: Facts and Figures 2015 (25th edition)
sources.use: Historical corroboration only. Superseded for seasonal planning by 2024. Northern rainy-season months differ from later reports; no automatic planting-onset/calendar alert or numerical soil/rain threshold is drawn from it.
sources.file: Statistic Research on Information Directorate of the MoFA-25th edition.pdf

sources.title: Funding of Agricultural Research and Development in Ghana: The Case of Council for Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)
sources.publisher: Roland Asare and George Owusu Essegbey; Technology and Investment / Scientific Research Publishing
sources.use: Agricultural R&D funding and policy study. Not a MoFA crop-production guide or weather bulletin. Reviewed and excluded from all operational recommendations and weather alerts.
